She became interested in medical aesthetics after discovering the field allowed her to combine her love of working collaboratively with patients/clients and using her clinical skills to achieve her clients’ desired results. Kim began her career in 2001 working as a registered nurse on orthopedics and surgical care inpatient units. She has been working in occupational health as a nurse practitioner since 2016. She has years of experience with skin assessments, administering injections, and suturing. She received her medical aesthetics training in Botox and fillers through Aesthetic Medical Educators Training (AMET), and has also completed continuing education with Allergan and Galderma. ​ Kim lives in Brunswick with her husband, two children, and three dogs. She is a born and raised Vermonter; moving to Brunswick in 2015.
